entry.title: Claude Meetings auto-join limited on the Team plan
entry.content:
Nov 19, 02:15 UTC
Resolved - Claude Meetings (beta) is joining calls normally. Enterprise and Team customers can add Claude to calls. Auto-join is available for all Enterprise customers and some Team customers. We'll continue rolling out auto-join to additional Team customers in the coming days.

Nov 17, 23:39 UTC
Update - Claude Meetings (beta) is joining calls more reliably, and we are monitoring it. It remains enabled for all Enterprise customers. Team customers can again add Claude to new calls manually, and Auto-join is being restored gradually for Team customers.

Nov 17, 02:02 UTC
Identified - Claude Meetings (beta) saw higher than expected demand today, and Claude was unable to join many calls. We have put mitigations in place and are continuing to monitor and improve join reliability.

Claude Meetings is now re-enabled for all Enterprise customers, though Claude may take a little longer than usual to join. Adding Claude to new calls and Auto-join remain paused for Team customers. We will share more updates as we expand capacity and begin restoring the feature for Team customers.

Nov 16, 18:10 UTC
Update - Claude may still be unable to join some calls in Claude Meetings (beta), and Auto-join remains paused. Calls already in progress and other Claude features are not affected. We expect this to take some time to fully resolve and will post an update when the status changes.

Nov 16, 16:27 UTC
Update - We have temporarily paused Auto-join while we work on this. Adding Claude to a call by hand is also affected. Calls already in progress are not affected. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

Nov 16, 15:12 UTC
Update - We are continuing to investigate an issue preventing Claude from joining new calls in Claude Meetings (beta).

Nov 16, 15:10 UTC
Investigating - We are investigating an issue preventing Claude from joining new calls in Claude Meetings (beta). Calls already in progress are not affected, and core functionality is not impacted. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

entry.title: Elevated errors affecting the Microsoft 365 connector
entry.content:
Nov 13, 21:49 UTC
Resolved - This incident has been resolved. From 08:03 PT / 16:03 UTC on November 12 to 08:40 PT / 16:40 UTC on November 13, mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector and Claude for Outlook returned errors for many requests because of a Microsoft 365 service incident. Microsoft is still completing its recovery, so you may see occasional errors or delays.

Nov 13, 15:40 UTC
Monitoring - We're seeing signs of recovery for the Microsoft 365 connector. Claude for Outlook is also recovering. Some SharePoint search requests are still returning errors. Microsoft's incident remains open, so errors may return. We're continuing to monitor and will update this post as soon as we have more info.

Nov 12, 22:23 UTC
Update - This issue is caused by a Microsoft 365 service incident, and mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector are still failing for most requests. Claude for Outlook remains affected. You can follow Microsoft's progress at https://status.cloud.microsoft. We will update this post when service is restored.

Nov 12, 21:18 UTC
Update - We are continuing to work with our upstream provider, who is restarting affected servers. Mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector are still failing for most requests, and Claude for Outlook remains affected. We will provide another update as soon as we have more information.

Nov 12, 20:28 UTC
Update - We are continuing to work with our upstream provider on this issue. Mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector are still failing for most requests. Claude for Outlook is also affected: mail and calendar actions may fail, and some users may not be able to open the add-in. We will provide another update within the hour.

Nov 12, 18:34 UTC
Identified - We have identified an issue with an upstream provider affecting the Microsoft 365 connector. Mail, calendar and search tools are failing for most requests, and new connections to the connector may not complete. We are in contact with them and will provide an update as soon as possible.

Nov 12, 17:52 UTC
Investigating - We are investigating elevated errors and slow responses affecting the Microsoft 365 connector. Requests to mail, SharePoint, Teams chat and calendar through the connector may fail, and new connections to the connector may not complete. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

Existing connectors, including Docs and Sheets, are working again, and Claude Managed Agents and Claude Meetings are recovering. Adding a new connector on claude.ai is temporarily unavailable.
